1 ” to allow audio playback ASPECTS OF TRADITIONAL CULTURE IN THE COUNTY [Music] Hallo learner, welcome to social studies for grade 4. Today we will talk about aspects of traditional culture in the county. Your radio teacher is Esther Simaloi. Welcome to the program [Music]

2 ” to allow audio playback Hello grade 4 learner, welcome to our social studies lesson. Today we are going to learn about the aspects of traditional culture and tell how culture is expressed in our county. Culture is the way of life of people in our community. Culture is the way of life of people in a community. What is community #Bell# A Community is a group of people living in a particular local area they interact together in their day to day life they share a common belief and values. in the past each community had its special way of life a way of doing things that is different from others. This is what we call culture or tradition. Which is your community? Which is your community? #Bell# From which county is your community? From which county is your community? #Bell# Culture was the way of life of the people in the past and is still the way of people in the present. What aspect of your culture were practiced in the past and are still practiced in the present? How do you show your culture today? #Bell# Different communities have different cultures they show their culture in the way they do their things for example: The kind of food they eat. The kind of food they eat. The kind they wear. The clothes they wear. The houses they live in. The houses they live in. The way they conduct their ceremonies such as marriage initiation and naming ceremonies Which cultural foods did people in your community eat? Which cultural foods did people in your community eat? #Bell# Which materials did people in your community use to built their houses? Which materials did people in your community use to built their houses? #Bell# Learner, do you still eat the foods that people in your community ate in the past today? #Bell# Other ways in which people expressed their culture are; through games and sports they played for entertainment Do you play games with your friends Which games do you play that people in your community used to play? #Bell#

3 ” to allow audio playback Culture is expressed through music and dance. Do you sing and dance? Do you sing and dance? #Bell# Sing and dance to your favourite song. I hope it was a traditional song, sang by the people in your community. Traditional songs and dances communicated different important messages. They were also good for entertainment. Songs were sang on different occasions. Name such occasions. #Bell# Good: We have victory songs sang after victory in a war, wedding ceremony songs, naming ceremony songs and initiation ceremony songs The other way people expressed their culture is by the ceremonies they held to mark major events in their lives this include; 1. Naming ceremonies 2. Wedding ceremonies 3. Initiation ceremonies Learner have you taken part in any ceremony in your community? #Bell# Which one was it? Why did they have that ceremony? #Bell# Some traditional aspects are still practiced today. Identify the aspects of culture that you still practice today in your community. #Bell# Good : I hope your answers include; the foods we eat, our dressing or music and dance. Are their aspects of your culture that you do not practice today in your community? #Bell# Why don't we practice the cultural aspects? #Bell# Culture is important because; It identifies who we are It helps us to learn other people's culture It attracts tourists Different aspects of culture help us to learn more about the culture of other people these in turn promote appreciation of other people's culture. To conclude, it is good to note that in the past people carried out their day to day activities differently these activities became the practices and later this practices became the culture of the people, the way of life. Ask your parents, guardians and grandparents to teach you a traditional song performed in a traditional ceremony in your community. That brings us to the end of our lesson today. Until next time, Goodbye.
